functions.name: QUESTIONS
functions.description: Spills a table of questions (id, name, headline prob, 24h change, number of rungs, headline rung), biggest 24h movers first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text the question name must contain, e.g. "taiwan". Empty = all.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional entity name or id, e.g. "Iran": only questions involving it.

functions.name: ENTITY
functions.description: Spills the questions involving a country, person or organisation (id, name, prob, 24h change, status, 24h volume, rungs), live and most traded first.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Entity name, e.g. "Iran" or "Xi Jinping" (or a Wikidata id such as wd:Q794).

functions.name: PROB
functions.description: Probability (0-1). q: = the question's headline rung (most-traded live rung; it can switch), prop: = one rung blended across venues, mkt: = one venue's own price.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: CHANGE
functions.description: 24-hour change in probability of a proposition or a question's headline rung (e.g. 0.05 = +5 points).

functions.name: NAME
functions.description: The wording of a question, rung or venue contract, e.g. "Will China blockade Taiwan?"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: FIELD
functions.description: One detail of a question, rung or venue contract: name, prob, status, volume_24h, open_interest, updated, close_time (dates as Excel dates); questions also headline, headline_id, n_rungs, n_live, venues; rungs also question, n_markets, venues; contracts (mkt:) also title, rules, rules_secondary, resolution_sources, outcomes, venue, match.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: RUNGS
functions.description: Spills a question's ladder: one row per rung (id, name, deadline, threshold, prob, 24h change, status, headline), latest deadline first.

functions.name: CONTRACTS
functions.description: Spills the venue contracts behind a question (its live rungs) or a rung: id, venue, name, rung, relation (same_as = blended; near_equivalent = similar, not blended), prob, 24h volume, open interest, updated, close time, rules.

functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Restated probability over time (date, prob, n_markets): today's contracts for the rung applied to every past day. A q: id uses its current headline rung.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional start date. Default 30 days before end; must be on or before end.
